db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (50%) to L-K6 L12W K: 33%; L: 20%, V: 13%. Activity: active against Gram+ E. faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 64 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or 9144 (MIC 64-128 ug/ml), S.pneumoniae ATCC 49619 (MIC 128 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 or 23506 (MIC 64-128 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 2 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 8 ug/ml), fungi A.niger ATCC 16404 (MIC 256 ug/ml), C.albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 256 ug/ml), and C.glabrata ATCC 15126 (MIC >256 ug/ml). mainly Gram-. In vitro toxicity: 4% human RBC: 10% hemolysis at 512 ug/ml. Structure: helical in SDS or DPC.

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (50%) to Nigrocin-HLM K: 33%; L: 20%, V: 13%. Activity: active against Gram+ E.faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 128 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or 9144 (MIC 64 ug/ml), S.pneumoniae ATCC 49619 (MIC 128 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 or 23506 (MIC 64-128 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 32 ug/ml), P.aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 256 ug/ml), fungi A.niger ATCC 16404 (MIC 256 ug/ml), C.albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 128 ug/ml), and C.glabrata ATCC 15126 (MIC 256 ug/ml). SAR: sequence reversal reduced peptide activity by 4-fold, indicating the importance of the native AMP. In vitro toxicity: 4% human RBC: no hemolysis at the MIC. Structure: helical in SDS or DPC.

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (71.43%) to HH235 W: 33%, R: 25%; P: 17%. GRAVY: -1.325; Mol Wt: 1780.155; Mol formula: C90H130N26O13, mol ex coeff: 22200. Activity: active against Gram+ E. faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 16 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or 9144 (MIC 16 ug/ml), S. pneumoniae ATCC 49619 (MIC 8 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 or 23506 (MIC 16-32 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 8 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 16 ug/ml), fungi A. niger ATCC 16404 (MIC 64 ug/ml), C.albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 128 ug/ml), and C.glabrata ATCC 15126 (MIC 128 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: 4% human RBC: < 10% hemolysis at 512 ug/ml. Structure: features TBA. Animal model:rat:Wound healing: Omiganan-alone and combined with imipenem-was associated with a better control of inflammatory parameters than imipenem alone. Clinical trials: Indolicidin derivatives were subjected to clinical trials. In a recent phase 2 clinical trial (topical, twice a day for 28 days), omiganan reduces S. aureus and increases microbial diversity, but did not improve clinical sympotoms of patients with mild-to-moderate atopic dermatitis (AD), indicating inadequcy of this mono-treatment ( van der Kolk et al., 2020).

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (66.67%) to Omiganan W: 33%, R: 25%; P: 17%. Activity: active against Gram+ E. faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 16 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or 9144 (MIC 8 ug/ml), S. pneumoniae ATCC 49619 (MIC 8 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 or 23506 (MIC 4-8 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 4 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 4 ug/ml), fungi A. niger ATCC 16404 (MIC 64 ug/ml), C.albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 32 ug/ml), and C. glabrata ATCC 15126 (MIC 64 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: 4% human RBC: >10% hemolysis at 512 ug/ml. Structure: features TBA.

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (48%) to Omega76 W: 33%, R: 25%; P: 17%. Activity: active against Gram+ E. faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 64 ug/ml), S. aureus ATCC 25923 or 9144 (MIC 64-128 ug/ml), S. pneumoniae ATCC 49619 (MIC 4 ug/ml), Gram- E. coli ATCC 25922 or 23506 (MIC 2-8 ug/ml), K. pneumoniae ATCC 700603 (MIC 0.25 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 2 ug/ml), fungi A. niger ATCC 16404 (MIC 32 ug/ml), C.albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 256 ug/ml), and C.glabrata ATCC 15126 (MIC 128 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: 4% human RBC: not hemo.lytic till 512 ug/ml. Structure: less helical in SDS or DPC after sequence reversal.
